items.question: How does Flexlore use AI?
items.answer_html: It splits a recorded video into steps, drafts written instructions and creates a short quiz from the content. Every draft is reviewed and approved by your team before it goes out.

items.question: Who is Flexlore for?
items.answer_html: Teams where the job is learned by doing: restaurants and café chains, production lines, hotels, franchises, warehouses and bakeries.

items.question: Do I need technical skills?
items.answer_html: No. If you can film with a phone, you can create a step-by-step video SOP.

items.question: What does it take to get started?
items.answer_html: A phone and one real job. Film it, check what the AI drafted, then assign it. On the demo call we build one of your jobs with you.

items.question: Which devices does it run on?
items.answer_html: iOS and Android for your team. A web panel for managers is coming soon.

items.question: Who can see our content?
items.answer_html: You decide. Access is set by role and location, so people see only the jobs meant for them. Our Privacy, Security and Sub-processors pages cover how data is handled.

items.question: Which languages are supported?
items.answer_html: Flexlore is available in 8 languages: English, Turkish, German, Arabic, Spanish, Russian, French and Polish.

items.question: How is it priced?
items.answer_html: Plans are priced by number of users: Free covers 3, Pro 10 and ProPlus 30. Enterprise starts at 30+ users.

items.question: How is Flexlore priced?
items.answer_html: By number of users. Free covers 3 users, Pro 10 and ProPlus 30. Enterprise starts at 30+ users with custom pricing. Monthly and yearly prices are listed on this page.

items.question: What does unlimited mean?
items.answer_html: Unlimited items are subject to fair use and are meant for your own team's normal use. If your usage is unusually high, our team will contact you to talk about the right plan.

items.question: Do AI features cost extra?
items.answer_html: The AI features listed for each plan are included in its price, within the limits shown, such as the number of quizzes and subtitle languages.

items.question: Can I add users or storage?
items.answer_html: Yes. Extra users and extra storage are available on the web. Our team sets the price for your needs, so contact us.

items.question: Can I change plans later?
items.answer_html: Yes. Tell us which plan you want to move to. How a change is billed is set out in our Subscription & Billing policy.

items.question: How do I cancel?
items.answer_html: You can cancel at any time. How cancellation works for monthly and yearly billing is set out in our Subscription & Billing policy.

items.question: Where is our data stored?
items.answer_html: Our Privacy Policy, Data Processing and Sub-processors pages list where data is processed and by whom. Still have questions? Ask us on the demo call.

items.question: Who checks what the AI writes?
items.answer_html: You do. Steps, instructions and quizzes stay drafts until your team approves them.
